cp_sat_time_limit_scope: search only; unchanged backend also constructs a greedy hint; end-to-end wall time recorded separately
failure_metric: existing operational_cost fallback; failures retained in denominators and W/T/L
inference: descriptive; no new primary hypothesis, tuning, selection, or LLM calls
runtime: First measured uncached call per distinct program/instance; shared by identical frozen winner memberships. Earlier repeated calls retained, but only the canonical first measured call contributes to runtime summaries.
selection_uses: archive paths and format validation only; no solution outcomes

timing_amendment.basis: runtime/resource feasibility only; no heuristic solution-quality outcome used for amendment
timing_amendment.caveat: single-call runtime summaries are descriptive; no external latency-matched claim
timing_amendment.reason: Initial reference-interpreter timings make all-member warmup plus three repeats prohibitively slow at 300/500 vertices. Reduce redundant timing work without changing selected instances, programs, algorithm code, oracle settings, or original experiment configuration.
timing_amendment.records: All initial warmup and repeated observations remain in results/external/calls.json.
